empty.drop: Drop an audio or video file
empty.lead: Open an audio or video file, or drag it here (MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI…).
empty.note: Audio is extracted from video files automatically. Everything runs locally and nothing leaves your computer.
file.delete_title: Removes the app's data for this file; the original file on your disk stays
player.hint: Drag across the waveform to mark a fragment.
transcript.heading: Transcript
transcript.again_title: Transcribe this file again with another model or language
transcript.waiting: Waiting for the audio to be prepared…
transcript.loading: Loading model {model}. On first use it is downloaded, which can take a few minutes…
transcript.running: Transcribing: {pct}%, model {model}. Text appears as it is recognised.
transcript.done: Done: model {model}, language {language}, took {duration} ({ratio} × the recording's length).
search.placeholder: Search for a word or phrase…
search.exact_title: Without it, a word also matches its other forms, for example “contract” finds “contracts” and “umowa” finds “umowy”. Case, accents and punctuation never matter.
search.add: Add as a fragment to compare or export
fragments.heading: Fragments
fragments.empty: Mark a fragment on the waveform or add a search result with +. Two fragments, the loop and keys 1 and 2 give a quick A/B comparison.
fragments.wav_title: Download the fragment cut to the exact sample, uncompressed
fragments.original_title: Download the fragment in its original codec, without re-encoding (edges accurate to a codec frame, about 20 to 30 ms)
library.delete_confirm: Remove “{name}” from the app's library? The original file on your disk stays.
upload.error: Could not send the file to the app.
general.language_note: The language of a recording is chosen for each file when you add it, independently of the interface language.
transcription.intro: Preselected in the dialog that opens when you add a file, where you choose the recording language and the model for that file.
transcription.auto_note: “Detect automatically” recognises the language from the first 30 seconds of speech.
playback.follow: Scroll the text along with playback
playback.key_fragment: play the fragment with that number
playback.note: Mark a fragment by dragging across the waveform, or with “+” next to a search result. Clicking a word in the transcript plays the recording from there.
updates.auto: Check for and download updates automatically (once a day)
updates.privacy: The app only asks GitHub's public API for the list of releases, without sending anything about you or this computer. A downloaded package is verified with SHA-256 and installed the next time the app starts.
updates.idle_auto: The app checks for a newer version on its own.
updates.ready: Version {version} is downloaded and verified. It will be installed the next time the app starts.
data.note: Your original files stay where they are. The app keeps a copy of the audio track, a preview for listening and the transcript; “Remove from library” deletes them for that file.
dialog.note: The language spoken in the recording, independent of the interface language. “Detect automatically” recognises it from the first 30 seconds of speech.
models.desc.large-v3-turbo: Good quality for Polish and English; transcription takes about a quarter of the recording's length. Model file: 1.6 GB.
models.desc.small: Several times faster than turbo, but clearly weaker, especially for Polish. Model file: about 0.5 GB.
models.desc.medium: In between small and turbo. Model file: about 1.5 GB.
models.desc.large-v3: The most accurate, several times slower than turbo. Model file: about 3.1 GB.
error.file_not_found: This file is not in the library.
error.busy: The file is being processed. Try again when it finishes.
error.delete_failed: Could not delete all of the data ({reason}). Try again.
error.not_ready: The file is not ready yet.
error.already_transcribing: This file is already being transcribed.
error.no_copy: This track cannot be cut without re-encoding. Use WAV.
error.restart_window_only: Restarting works only in the app window.
error.no_window: The app is running without a window.
error.unrecognized: Not a recognised audio or video file ({detail}).
error.no_audio: The file has no audio track.
error.interrupted: Preparation was interrupted when the app closed. Add the file again.
error.update_foreign_host: Refusing to download from outside GitHub ({host}).
error.update_bad_url: The file address does not lead to the {repo} releases.
error.update_too_large: The file is larger than an app package can be.
error.update_wrong_package: The package does not contain Mysttic Audition {version}.
error.update_no_checksum: The checksum file does not cover the package.
error.update_checksum_mismatch: The package's SHA-256 checksum does not match.
error.update_rate_limited: GitHub is limiting requests right now. Try again later.
